summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Golar LNG Limited reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 19, 2026, in Bermuda. The meeting covered routine matters: setting the maximum number of directors at eight, authorizing the board to fill vacancies, re-electing eight directors, reappointing Ernst & Young LLP as auditors, and approving director fees not exceeding US$2 million for 2026. No special situations such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or other extraordinary events are mentioned. The filing is a standard annual meeting update with no implications for a special-situations event.
